videos.title: Why Would Jensen’s Return to NVIDIA End the Risk-Off Market Regime When His Leaving Didn’t Cause It?
videos.description:
This morning, Darius Dale joined Michelle Fleury on BBC News’ Business Today to explain why Jensen Huang’s return to NVIDIA may not be enough to stabilize markets.

42 Macro’s systems remain risk-off as inflation, monetary policy, and liquidity continue to present headwinds. More importantly, a politically induced slowdown in data-center construction could weaken the growth cycle before those headwinds begin to ease.
